Love,Ⓒs.Ⓓpreman m. n., aBilAzaH, snehaH, rAgaH, vAtsalyaM, anurAgaH; praRayaH, BAvaH, prIti f., prema-prIti-sneha-BAvaH (all with loc.); ‘l(ove) for God’ ISvaraBakti f.
Ⓑ
 2 (Amorous) kAmaH, anaMgarAgaH, SfMgAraH, SfMgAraBAvaH, rati f., ratisuKaM, madanaH.
Ⓑ
 3 (God of love) kAmaH, madanaH, smaraH; See Cupid.
Ⓑ
 4 dayA, anu-kaMpA.
Ⓑ
 5 ruci f., aBiruciH, Asakti f., vyasanaM, aBiniveSaH, prItiH.
Ⓑ
 6 (Darling) priyaH-yA, priyatamaH-mA, dayitaH-tA; ‘to fall or be in l(ove) with’ snih 4 P, anuraMj pass., BAvaM-aBilAzaM-baMD 9 P or niviS c., anurAgavat-badDaBAva-mohita- a. BU; ‘l(ove)-affected’, ‘l(ove)-stricken’, ‘under the influence of l(ove)’ anaMgatapta-pIqita, kAmArta, kAmavaSa, kAmAtura, anaMgaviDura, madanAvasTa, smarAkula, kAmAsakta; ‘to make l(ove)’ vivA-hArTaM prArT 10 A or ArAD c.; ‘gestures of l(ove)’ SfMgAracezwA, hAvaH, vilAsaH, viBramaH, lIlA, BAvaH; ‘l(ove)-knot’ premagraMTiH-baMDaH; ‘l(ove)-letter’ anaMga-madana-leKaH, manmaTa-leKaH; ‘l(ove)-match’ prema-vivAha-saMbaMDaH; ‘l(ove)-quarrel’ praRaya-prema-prIti-kalahaH; praRaya-kopaH; ‘l(ove)-sick’ kAmArta, kAmAtura, kAma-pIqita, anaMgatapta, viDura, madanavihvala; ‘l(ove)-song’ SfMgAragItaM; ‘l(ove)-tale’ prema-SfMgAra-kaTA; ‘l(ove)-token’ prItilakzaRaM, premABijYAnaM.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓkam 10 A (amorously); prI-anu-raMj-AsaMj pass.; gen. ex. by snih (with loc.); baMD, niviS c. with (s.); ‘the king l(ove)s Sāgarikā’ nfpaH sAgari [] kAyAM badDAnurAgaH, AsaktacittaH, kftapraRayaH, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 ruc 1 A, AnaMd 1 P, mud 1 A, tuz 4 P (with instr.); ex. by priya a.; See Fond, Like; ‘I l(ove) music’ saMgIta-priyosmi; ‘l(ove) knowledge’ vidyAsakta-citto Bava.
Ⓝ[Lov]able,Ⓒa.ⒹsnehArha, priya.
Ⓝ[Lov]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓpriya, dayita, kAMta, izwa, aBIpsita, snigDa, hfdya, manIzita.
Ⓝ[Lov]er,Ⓒs.Ⓓ(Amorous) kA-mukaH, kAmin m., kAMtaH, priyaH, dayitaH, va-llaBaH, ramaRaH, nAyakaH, izwaH, prAReSaH, jIvi-teSaH.
Ⓑ
 2 praRayin m., anurAgin m., nirataH, sevI-priyaH in comp.; ‘l(over) of knowledge’ priyajYAnaH, jYAnanirataH, jYAnepsuH; ‘a l(over) of learned men’ AgamavfdDasevI (R. vi. 41).
Ⓝ[Lov]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹpraRayin, anurAgavat, sasneha, praRayavat, prItimat, vatsala, anurakta, anurAgin, Asakta, priya, ni-, rata, sevin in comp.; ‘l(oving) gambling’ dyUtAsakta, dyUtasevin; ‘a l(oving) husband’ anurAgavAn patiH; ‘l(oving) kindness’ kfpA, dayA, kAruRyaM, vAtsalyaM, prasAdaH, anugrahaH, snehaH, anukaMpA.
Ⓝ[Lov]ingly,Ⓒadv.Ⓓsa-praRayaM, sasnehaM, sAnurAgaM, snehena, vAtsalyAt, prItipUrvaM.
ⓃLovely,Ⓒa.ⒹkAMta, suMdara (rI f.), rucira, SoBana, suBaga, manojYa, maMju, maMjula, cAru, manorama, manohara, lalita, vAma, mugDa, kamanIya, aBirAma; See Beautiful.
Ⓝ[Love]liness,Ⓒs.ⒹkAMti f., sOMdaryaM, SoBA, SrIH, lAvaRyaM, suBagatA, cArutA; See Beauty.
